title: The 30th Rung: LA Marzulli Says Roswell UFO Disclosure Has Reached a Turning Point
excerpt: According to L.A. Marzulli, a government document release may have just brought the nation one step closer to confronting what really happened in 1947.
content:
Nearly 80 years after one of America’s most mysterious incidents, the Roswell UFO controversy is back in the spotlight. According to Christian researcher L.A. Marzulli, a government document release may have brought the nation one step closer to confronting what really happened in 1947.

In a recent episode of his YouTube program, The 30th Rung of UFO Disclosure Is Here!, Marzulli examined the reported release of a decades-old affidavit from Walter Haut, the former public information officer at Roswell Army Air Field.

The document, reportedly included in a seventh batch of government UFO files released in late October, contains extraordinary claims about an unidentified craft, unusual wreckage and bodies allegedly recovered near Roswell, New Mexico.

For Marzulli, the bigger question is why the government would release such an account at all.

“Are they signaling us by releasing this that Roswell was real?” Marzulli asked. “Is it their way of sort of coming clean after 79 years of deliberate obfuscation?”

An Egg-Shaped Craft and Mysterious Bodies

The affidavit, written in 2002 and made public after Haut died in 2005, describes an alleged encounter inside Hangar 84 at Roswell.

According to the account Marzulli read, Haut claimed to have observed a metallic, egg-shaped object approximately 12 to 15 feet long and six feet high. The object reportedly had no visible windows, wings, landing gear or propulsion system.

But the most startling part of the testimony concerned what Haut claimed was lying nearby.

“Also, from a distance, I was able to see a couple of bodies under a canvas tarpaulin,” Haut stated in the affidavit, according to Marzulli’s reading.

Haut reportedly described unusually large heads and body proportions resembling those of a 10-year-old child.

These claims remain unverified, and the government’s reported publication of the affidavit does not establish that its extraordinary allegations are true.

Was Roswell’s Official Explanation a Cover-Up?

Marzulli also challenged the military’s longstanding explanation that the debris recovered in 1947 came from a weather balloon.

Drawing on his own investigations and interviews with members of the family of military intelligence officer Jesse Marcel, Marzulli argued that the original witnesses encountered something far more unusual.

He pointed to accounts of thin but remarkably strong metallic material and claims that the wreckage displayed publicly was substituted for what had actually been recovered.

Marzulli also discussed visiting the alleged debris field and investigating a piece of metal his team recovered there. Although he described the material as an unusual aluminum alloy, he acknowledged that additional testing is necessary.

For Marzulli, the inclusion of Haut’s affidavit in a government release represents another reason to question the official narrative.

“In my opinion, our government because of what was released is basically signaling that Roswell was real,” he said.

Is Something Bigger Coming?

Marzulli also connected the renewed Roswell discussion to Steven Spielberg’s “Disclosure Day,” speculating that the filmmaker may have encountered previously unseen footage of the incident.

However, Marzulli acknowledged that this theory is conjecture rather than fact.

His closing remarks took an even more ominous turn.

“Something is coming,” Marzulli warned, encouraging viewers to prepare at least two weeks of emergency food and water.

What is clear is that Marzulli sees this existing conversation surrounding Roswell as entering a new phase, one that could force Americans to reconsider a mystery that has endured for nearly eight decades.
